name: Mem0
summary: Mem0 is a memory layer that extracts facts from conversations and retrieves them for later prompts. It ships as an Apache-2.0 library and self-hostable server, and as a hosted platform that adds graph memory and Dream background consolidation on paid plans.
facts: REST API; Python and TypeScript SDKs, CLI; hosted remote MCP server (mcp.mem0.ai)
Managed platform; self-hosted Apache-2.0 server; on-prem (Kubernetes, private cloud or air-gapped) on Enterprise
Free tier; Starter $19/mo; Pro $249/mo; Enterprise custom
SOC 2 Type I, HIPAA, GDPR; BYOK (vendor-stated)
goodFor: Adding user memory to an existing app quickly
Teams that want open source with a hosted option
watchOut: Published scores include managed-platform optimizations not in open source
Graph memory and Dream are paid-plan features
Benchmark comparisons use each vendor's own runs, not one harness
